key_findings: The paper 'Attention Is All You Need' is a 2017 research paper in machine learning, authored by eight scientists and engineers working at Google, according to the Wikipedia source (Attention_Is_All_You_Need_-_Wikipedia).

Google Research's page identifies the paper as 'Attention is All You Need' and describes it as research conducted across Google, with teams driving innovation through research, systems engineering, and collaboration across Google (research.google/pubs/attention-is-all-you-need/).
Ashish Vaswani, a co-author of the 2017 paper, conducted research at Google Brain, confirming the Google association for at least one of the authors (Ashish_Vaswani_-_Wikipedia).
The arXiv abstract pages present the paper's title and describe the Transformer architecture but do not list the full author names or affiliations in the fetched content.
gaps: The evidence does not list the complete names of all eight authors of the paper.
